participantElections.label: Ground for removal — Administrative Rule 40(b) or 40(c) (selection)
participantElections.why: Administrative Rule 40 gives two grounds and this packet is built for the rule, not for one of them. Rule 40(b) is for issues of a sensitive and highly personal nature; Rule 40(c) is for a likelihood of substantial physical harm to members of your household, and the form notes that a 40(c) removal lasts five years and must then be renewed. Which fits your case is yours to say
